svg.title: Weakness localization: rule out mimics, decide upper or lower motor neuron from the exam, then the pattern of weakness, sensory findings and pain place the lesion in the brain, brainstem, spinal cord, anterior horn cell, root, plexus, nerve, neuromuscular junction or muscle

svg.text: WEAKNESS: loss of voluntary movement from a break anywhere, cerebrum to muscle fibre

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: first rule out mimics: incoordination (cerebellar) · apraxia (cortical) · severe sensory loss (proprioceptive failure)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: history: where (one limb, one side, both) · how (abrupt or gradual) · what is hard · sensory, speech or swallowing, pain, bowel

svg.text: • PYRAMIDAL: arm extensors and leg flexors weak first

svg.text: • atrophy · fasciculations possible (anterior horn cell, nerve)

svg.text: • reflexes normal, ↓ or absent · tone normal · downgoing plantar
